name: Inbox
tagline: Notifications as a two-pane, keyboard inbox
summary: Your GitHub notifications as a two-pane inbox: a list on the left, the full pull request or issue on the right. Triage from the keyboard: read, done, save, unsubscribe.

flow.label: Inbox route
flow.note: /inbox starts loading the unread list without waiting for it and renders InboxPage.

flow.label: InboxPage
flow.note: Owns the view, grouping, selection and keyboard shortcuts; lays out list and preview.

flow.label: getNotifications
flow.note: Returns the visible threads for the signed-in user, each with its subject state.

flow.label: Notifications API
flow.note: Lists threads with the OAuth token, then reads each subject plus its comments and reviews.

flow.label: InboxPreview
flow.note: Shows the selected thread with the same detail content the pull request and issue pages use.

flow.label: useInboxActions
flow.note: Updates both cached lists first, calls GitHub, and restores them with a toast on failure.

features.name: Unread, All and Saved
features.summary: Three views. Saved is DiffKit's own: GitHub has no public API for it, so up to 200 saved threads are kept per user in the browser.

features.name: Grouping and collapsing
features.summary: Group by repository (latest activity first) or by reason (ordered by how much it asks of you). Groups collapse and the choice is remembered.

features.name: Keyboard triage
features.summary: J/K or arrows move, E marks done, S saves, Shift+M unsubscribes, Enter opens. After a removal the selection moves to the next row.

features.name: Inline preview
features.summary: Selecting a row marks it read and opens the pull request or issue beside the list. On phones it goes to the full page.

features.name: Thread actions
features.summary: Mark read, mark done, unsubscribe (ignore the thread, then mark it done), mark all read, and mark everything read and unsaved as done.

features.name: State-aware rows
features.summary: Each row shows an open, closed or merged icon, the title, repository and number, the reason, and an unread dot or saved pin.
